intro.title: About Akeli
intro.lead: Akeli realigns African cuisine with modern life, using the tools of modernity. Not a diet — a way to bring a cuisine and a lifestyle back in sync.

pillar1.title: Realignment
pillar1.body: Our lives have changed; our cuisine deserves to stay ours. Akeli adapts the dishes from home to your everyday — your habits, your energy, your profile. The change in your body follows naturally: an alignment, lived with pleasure.

pillar2.title: Talent is everywhere
pillar2.body: The right solution can come from anyone. Akeli trusts the collective and real results: creators of every background create recipes that genuinely work, and user feedback reveals what works, profile by profile.

pillar3.title: Fighting modernity with modernity
pillar3.body: Modern life — sedentary, urban, fast — pulled our cuisines away from our bodies. Akeli answers with the very tools of modernity: algorithms, real-world data, personalization. Technology brings our culinary heritage back in sync with life today, in the service of our culture and to carry it forward.
